title: Official level ranges for the nine new Forever dungeons
claim: Blizzard's dungeon overview (Oct 20) gives: Hall of Thanes 13-18 (below Ironforge), Ruins of Lordaeron 15-20 (above Undercity), Excavation Site 24-29 (Wetlands, near Thelgen Rock/Dun Algaz), City of Dalaran 28-33 (Alterac, via sewers after an attunement chain), The Drowned City 35-40 (underwater west of Grom'gol, STV), Krol'dok Stronghold 40-45 (Riverglades), Alcaz Prison 48-53 (Alcaz Island, Dustwallow), Blackmaw Hold 55-60 (Azshara), Shaper's Terrace 58-60 (northern Un'Goro); all 5-player.
detail: These are tighter than the fan ranges in n:20261011-dungeon-level-ranges (HoT 13-20, RoL 15-22, Excavation 26-33). Dalaran attunement: Alliance start 'An Alarming Request' (Emissary Jacques, Southshore); Horde 'Key to the City' and 'Prison Break-In' (Magus Wordeen Voidglare, Tarren Mill). Shaper's Terrace needs power crystals gathered across Un'Goro. Warcraft Tavern still lists Excavation Site 26-33 with quests from 24. No XP values given.

title: Recommended level ranges for all 14 Forever dungeons
claim: ForeverDB's dungeon list gives: Ragefire Chasm 13-18, Hall of Thanes 13-20, Wailing Caverns 15-24, Ruins of Lordaeron 15-22, Deadmines 17-26, Shadowfang Keep 20-30, Blackfathom Deeps 24-32, Stockade 24-32, Excavation Site: Wetlands 26-33, Gnomeregan 29-38, Razorfen Kraul 29-38, Scarlet Monastery 30-38, Razorfen Downs 37-46, Uldaman 41-51.
detail: Fan ranges (foreverdb.net, checked Oct 7; copied in DungeonLens). For the nine new Forever dungeons use Blizzard's official ranges in n:20261021-new-dungeon-levels-official (HoT 13-18, RoL 15-20, Excavation Site 24-29, Dalaran 28-33, Drowned City 35-40, Krol'dok 40-45, Alcaz 48-53, Blackmaw 55-60, Shaper's Terrace 58-60). Dungeon Leveling Companion's Alliance plan: HoT 14-17, DM 17-19, WC 19-20, RoL 20-21, BFD 22-24, RFK 25-26, Gnomer 28-30, SM GY 30-31, Dalaran 31-33, SM Lib 33-35, Drowned City 35-37, SM Arm 37-38, Cath 38-39, Krol'dok 42-44.

title: Beta closes Oct 23 10:00 PDT; launch Nov 4; raids Dec 9
claim: The beta goes offline Oct 21 for the stress test (2-6 p.m. PDT), reopens afterwards at cap 30 and closes permanently Friday Oct 23, 10:00 a.m. PDT (17:00 UTC); WoW Forever launches Nov 4, 2026; Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair unlock Dec 9.
detail: Beta close and extension from Kaivax's Oct 20 post (Wowhead: extended two days from Oct 21; maybe one more build). Launch time 3 p.m. PST (23:00 UTC) is from fan sites citing Blizzard's Forever page; Blizzard's Oct 20 posts don't restate it. Name reservation: n:20261010-name-reservation-oct27. Stress-test characters are wiped.

title: Name reservation Oct 27 - Nov 3 (EU 18:00 CET, NA 1 p.m. PDT); launch Nov 4
claim: Early name reservation opens Oct 27 at 18:00 CET (EU) / 1:00 p.m. PDT (NA), Oct 28 07:00 in Korea and Taiwan, and runs to Nov 3; up to three characters total across PvP, Normal and RP rulesets.
detail: Blizzard news Oct 20. Needs a pre-purchased Skyborne Heroic/Epic Pack, the Warcraft Forever Collection, the Digital Upgrade or the Collector's Edition. Reserving lets you pick the ruleset and name before launch; it does not start leveling early.

title: Spell haste lowers the global cooldown (intended; floor 1.0 s)
claim: Designer Aidan Moon closed forever-bugs #389 (Berserking lowers the GCD) as Not a Bug on Oct 21: spell haste lowers the GCD, with a floor of 1.0 s and a ceiling of 1.5 s.
detail: Applies to any spell haste (Troll Berserking, Skyborne 3% haste, Nature's Grace; #418 notes Nature's Grace reduces an instant's GCD twice, via haste and its own GCD cut, unanswered). For leveling it speeds instant-spam casters (shocks, DoTs, seals) under haste effects.

title: Racial base stats will use Classic offsets (fixed); Skyborne get their own
claim: The beta showed modern (Midnight) racial stat offsets (e.g. Orc +3/-3/+1/-1/0 vs Human, Classic +3/-3/+2/-3/+3); designer Aidan Moon says this is fixed to match Vanilla, and the two Skyborne races get their own, different offsets (#414, closed Fixed, Oct 21).
detail: Beta Skyborne currently -1 Str/+1 Agi/-1 Sta/+1 Int/0 Spi (reporter). Exact launch Skyborne values not given. Small leveling effect: Classic offsets restore e.g. Orc/Undead/Tauren Spirit bonuses and Night Elf +5 Agi.

title: Racial fixes: Touch of the Grave hits again, Earth Fury no longer needs a mace
claim: Designer answers on forever-bugs (Oct 21): Undead Touch of the Grave no longer misses nearly 100% of the time (#369, Fixed); Dwarf Earth Fury no longer requires a mace but its +2% crit damage doesn't work yet (crit healing does, #392); Tauren Endurance's +2% crit damage not applying is a known issue (#396).
detail: Touch of the Grave procs from spell casts and wand shots with a 25 s internal cooldown after the proc; the miss bug wasted the proc. Racials were reworked Oct 15 (n:20261017-racials-oct15).

title: Pet hit chance fixed: Hunter and Warlock pets inherit your hit
claim: Designer Aidan Moon (#394, Oct 20): pet hit was broken; Hunter pets now get melee hit equal to the Hunter's ranged hit and spell hit equal to 17/8 of it, and Warlock pets get spell hit equal to the Warlock's spell hit and melee hit equal to 8/17 of it.
detail: Reported via Lightning Breath missing despite the Hunter's hit. Hit gear and talents now raise pet damage while leveling, which matters for Hunter and Warlock solo kill speed.

title: Excavation Site quest Highland Hides (98815) pays 1,150 XP instead of ~6,100
claim: Highland Hides (98815, level-28 Excavation Site dungeon quest from James Halloran, Menethil Harbor) gives 1,150 XP on the beta, a level 14-16 regular-quest value, while the dungeon's other quests give 6,100 XP (#416).
detail: Warcraft Tavern's Excavation Site quest guide also calls it bugged with 'a meager reward of a little XP'. Requires Young Crocolisk Skins first, then 4 Thicket Raptor Hides inside. No Blizzard answer yet; check at launch before routing it.

title: Some group quests at dungeon entrances pay normal, not dungeon, quest XP
claim: A bug report (#417) says these dungeon-listed group quests give normal quest XP without the dungeon bonus: Collecting Memories (167) and Oh Brother... (168) for Deadmines, Trouble at the Docks (959), The Essence of Aku'mai (6563), and reportedly Shadowshard Fragments (7070) and Overmaster Pyron (4262).
detail: Objectives are done just outside the dungeons. Without 167/168 the Deadmines has 3 dungeon-XP quests vs Wailing Caverns' 4. The last two weren't checked in game. Pending approval, no designer reply. Model their XP as regular quest XP for now.

title: Mage hotfix Oct 20: Elemental Precision 3x2%, Piercing Ice removed, Ice Barrier/Frost Ward up
claim: An unannounced beta hotfix on Oct 20 changed Mage talents: Elemental Precision is 3 ranks of 2% hit (6%, was 5x1%); Piercing Ice (2/4/6% Frost damage) was removed; Ice Barrier rank 1 absorbs 493 (was 448) and adds 3% Frost damage for 1 min plus 3% while it holds; Frost Ward rank 1 absorbs 178 (was 162) plus 10% of Frost spell power; talents were reset.
detail: First reported on r/wowforever (Zipfte) and written up by ForeverDB; ForeverChanges lists the same hotfix with the Ice Barrier/Frost Ward numbers and tree moves (Frost Channeling to column 1, Improved Blizzard to column 2 of row 3; Frost Warding negates instead of reflecting). The beta was down ~20:00 UTC Oct 20 'for hotfixes' (EU forum). Server-side: client files still show the old talents. No Blizzard notes yet. Frost leveling loses Piercing Ice's 6% damage; Ice Barrier becomes a damage buff.

title: Quest log holds 40 quests (Classic: 20)
claim: WoW Forever's quest log holds 40 quests, double Classic Era's 20 (spotted in the beta client by MrGM on Sept 16, confirmed by testers).
detail: Reported by Bolverk Games (citing MrGM, PC Gamer, Warcraft Tavern) and Digital Citizen; also among hammerdance's 'hidden features' (ForeverDB couldn't find the 40 in client data). No Blizzard statement found. Glide's route.quest-log-near-cap/full heuristics assume 20: with 40 there's far less abandoning and more pre-accepting along a route.

title: Hunter: melee swings reset the Auto Shot timer (on top of the 0.5 s stand-still)
claim: Forever's Auto Shot needs 0.5 s standing still and is also reset by melee swings even when the shot was ready (#387); designer Aidan Moon closed it as feedback on Oct 21, with no change announced.
detail: Combines Era's 0.5 s cast with WotLK's linked swing timers; melee-weaving costs ranged shots. See n:20261017-wand-autoshot-stand-still.

title: Leveling past 30: Riverglades (mid-30s to mid-40s) and Mount Hyjal
claim: Blizzard's 'Your Leveling Journey Past 30' video (Oct 19) says Riverglades covers 'much of the mid-30s to mid-40s' with 150+ new quests and Mount Hyjal is the climax of leveling; the Krol'dok Stronghold dungeon there is 40-45.
detail: Icy Veins: Alliance reach Riverglades by a new path from Redridge; Alliance hub Farhold(e) Keep (Brotherhood of the Horse), Horde allied with the Bolder'ok ogres. Also Twilight's Shroud, a pirate chain, a horse rescue, the Bloodmaster's Ring. ForeverDB found the zone (UiMap 2548) and Hyjal (UiMap 2482) in the client, without level ranges. Neutral Tanaris boat: n:20261014-riverglades-boat-tanaris. Krol'dok Speed buff: n:20261021-kroldok-speed-buff.

title: Datamined: 'Krol'dok Speed' raises run speed in Stranglethorn and Riverglades
claim: The client has a 'Krol'dok Speed' spell that raises movement speed in Stranglethorn Vale and the Riverglades (ForeverDB client check); amount and source not known.
detail: Likely a zone travel buff like Blessing of Zephras (n:20261012-blessing-of-zephras-speed) or Westfall Stew's +15% (n:20261018-westfall-stew-speed-xp). Untestable on the beta (cap 30). Confirm at launch.

title: 1,808 new-in-Forever quest IDs confirmed (ForeverQuestMarker, build 70450)
claim: ForeverQuestMarker 0.1.3 (Oct 20, Forever build 1.60.1.70450 vs Era 1.15.9.70003) confirms 1,808 quest IDs as new in Forever (16 more than the 1,792 of build 69977); Glide's seed now holds 7,411 quest IDs with 2,785 new-in-Forever IDs in 1,540 ranges.
detail: Seven IDs entered the seed on Oct 21: 90930, 99435, 99470, 99582, 99600, 99602, 99670. Glide's QuestIDs.lua sweep list was regenerated. Community-confirmed and changed-quest lists follow from player reports.
